text: The facts of the cases, as submitted by the parties, may be summarised as follows.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In 2009-14, the applicants lodged notices of LGBT public assemblies as indicated in the Appendix.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In each instance, the local authorities refused to approve the dates proposed by the applicants for the LGBT public assemblies.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In each instance, the local authorities refused to approve the locations proposed by the applicants for the LGBT public assemblies.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicants challenged the local authorities' refusal decisions in the domestic courts under Chapter 25 of the Code of Civil Procedure.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The domestic courts upheld the decisions of the local authorities refusing to approve the dates and locations of the LGBT public assemblies.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In every case, the judicial decisions were taken after the respective dates of the originally proposed assemblies.
section_path: THE FACTS
